title: Build and rehearse the Product Launch Lab participant kit
summary: Record the shared kit, guided coach, branch-safe rehearsal, HealthOS dogfood, and idea-stage entry gate while the rehearsal PR still needs a passing participant check.

in: Record the participant workbook and guarded Git flow
Record the guided participant coach and identity boundary
Record the isolated rehearsal branch contract and HealthOS dogfood
out: No participant application data or private product source
No raw rehearsal merge to main
No merge of the open rehearsal PR
No organizer operations copied into participant materials

context: The participant repository was created as a separate surface from private organizer operations.
The durable lane spans the shared workbook, a one-step-at-a-time coach, a rehearsal branch contract, one HealthOS dogfood capsule, and an idea-stage entry path.
Rehearsal PR #1 remains open and its participant validation check is failing.

requirements.text: Provide a bounded three-round participant workbook and guarded main branch
Provide a one-step-at-a-time participant coach with separate GitHub and contact identities
Keep rehearsal work on test branch to rehearsal base, never raw to main
Support idea-stage participants through validation before build
Make the HealthOS rehearsal submission check pass and complete review of PR #1

description.jtbd: When a participant joins at idea, prototype, or working-product stage, give them a warm one-step coach and branch-safe artifacts that end in a reviewable launch capsule.
description.goal: A reusable participant kit proven through one isolated rehearsal without leaking participant or organizer-private data.
non_goals: Do not require a working landing before the Lab
Do not build the participant's product inside this repository
Do not auto-publish, message, invite, push, or merge for the participant

acceptance.text: The kit produces positioning, demo, distribution, and submission artifacts through three timeboxed rounds.
The coach asks for one next action at a time and keeps unsupported claims as hypotheses.
Test branches target rehearsal branches and raw rehearsal output never targets main.
Idea-stage participants are guided to a validation proof before a landing or build requirement.
HealthOS rehearsal PR #1 has a passing submission check and is ready for human review.

evidence.label: Participant workbook
evidence.note: Defines positioning, demo, distribution, and PR finish.

evidence.label: Participant coach skill
evidence.note: Defines the warm one-step coaching contract.

evidence.label: HealthOS rehearsal PR
evidence.note: Open draft PR targets the rehearsal branch and currently fails validate-submission.

evidence.label: Idea-stage coaching gate
evidence.note: Merged to main as 9bf72ab; its generic submission check failed but did not block the docs merge.

risks: Participant and contact identities can differ; Git ownership must use the GitHub handle.
A generic submission check can misclassify maintainer-only docs changes.
Raw participant or rehearsal output must not become a curated public example by accident.

inputs: Exact Product Launch Lab CCE sessions
constraints: Use a maintainer branch and reviewable PR for task-history changes
Keep participant content and private product source out of task JSON
Do not merge open rehearsal work
execution.output: One compact participant-kit recovery rail with exact branch, PR, and Git receipts.
escalate_if: The task-history PR would need participant data
Fixing rehearsal PR #1 requires changing another active participant branch

agents.handoff: Fix or classify the failing rehearsal submission check before PR #1 review.

session_refs.purpose: Recover participant repository creation, workbook, and guarded Git flow

recovery.outcome: The participant repository gained a three-round workbook and local protection against accidental main pushes.
decisions: Participant artifacts live in a separate repository from organizer operations.

iterations.goal: Give every participant a warm one-step coach without conflating Git and contact identities.

recovery.outcome: A repository-local coach now guides one current artifact and next action while keeping GitHub ownership separate from contact handles.
decisions: Use plain product questions first; frameworks remain optional scaffolding, not participant cargo cult.

iterations.goal: Prove the branch contract through an isolated HealthOS rehearsal capsule.

recovery.outcome: HealthOS produced a complete launch capsule on an isolated test branch, but the draft rehearsal PR still has a failing submission check.
decisions: Raw rehearsal merges test branch to rehearsal branch, never to main.
A curated example requires a separate maintainer PR later.
recovery.next_action: Fix or classify validate-submission on rehearsal PR #1, then return it for human review.

decisions: A working landing is desirable preparation, not an admission gate.
